mcqs.q: What was the theory of the four humours?
options: Disease was caused by imbalance of blood, phlegm, yellow bile and black bile; treatment aimed to rebalance them via bloodletting, purging or diet. It dominated for nearly 2,000 years.
Medieval doctors knew about germs but used humours because they had no medicine.
The four humours were invented by Pasteur to explain bacteria.
Slavery was abolished because cotton was no longer profitable.

mcqs.q: Why were railways transformative for Victorian Britain?
options: Slavery was abolished because cotton was no longer profitable.
They cut transport costs and times, integrated national markets, enabled commuting and mass leisure travel, and standardised time zones — reshaping economy and society after 1830.
Railways were transformative because they were the first form of public transport.
Railways were transformative mainly because they were faster than horses.
